profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in both the healthcare and logistics industries. Skilled in Javascript, React, and Java. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Engineering focused in Software Engineering from Iowa State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Implement business-driven features for a Java Spring healthcare payment integrity case management web application
-Conduct chaos experiments to determine potential points of failure; implement automated app restarts for servers with consistently high CPU levels, based on findings
-Produce Chef cookbooks to automatically deploy CPU resiliency solution to any newly provisioned servers for the application
-Utilize a Kafka consumer application, which automates case creation in our main application
-Design and implement/support different React and Node JS APIs that supports our main application

positions.title: .NET Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Engineer new pages and features for a .NET MVC web application
-Perform code reviews and generate QA reports for other developers’ stories
-Construct and modify stored procedures in SQL Server for application features
-Pioneered Moq testing framework usage, guiding team in adoption of testing standards

positions.title: .NET Developer Consultant
positions.description:
-Developed new features and enhancement for Logistics focused .NET web application
-Worked in a Kanban agile environment
-Maintained and utilized SQL Server database that integrates with web application
-Develop user metric reports with Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services

positions.title: Application Developer II
positions.description:
- Develop user stories in both Scrum and Kanban software development environments
- Create new user interfaces and business logic for a Java Spring MVC web application
- Write unit tests in Groovy through test-driven development
- Experience working with cross functional teams on enterprise-scale projects using git branches

positions.title: Peoplesoft Developer
positions.description:
- Built system enhancements for PeopleSoft Financials utilizing PeopleCode
- Delivered a new .NET web application utilizing Hive to process Hadoop big data
- Constructed design documents to help other developers support the application

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- Enhanced a clinical application in an iterative Waterfall development cycle
- Partnered with business analysts to interpret design documents and deliver business requirements
- Collaborated on a .NET project tracking intern employee statistics

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed PeopleSoft enhancements in a waterfall development team
- Wrote technical design documents to explain my enhancements
- Learned and utilized PeopleSoft Application Engine to make more dynamic enhancements

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
- Setup new computers for University faculty
- Troubleshoot problems and clean viruses from faculty computers
- Setup and maintain department machines on a campus network
